paper: WeVisForensics: agentic AI-generated video detection (Du, Li, Zhang, Sun, Li, Lyu, Tai; arXiv 2611.21373, Nanjing University + Tencent WeChat Vision)
training_set_in_paper: Not trained in SynthScope. The official release, inference only: the five LoRA adapters of HF tencent/WeVisForensics @ 9fa025a0 (Apache-2.0) on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B @ 851bf6e8, run by the official in-process transformers backend (demo/wvf_local.py @ 43ae1c0, unmodified) in a separate process with transformers 5.23.0, greedy decoding, audio tools off (has_audio=False for every clip). The verdict is the agent's answer; AUROC ranks the fake-minus-real logit at the final verdict token. Fidelity (job 295351, RTX A5000): answers, tool calls, every turn's raw text and the verdicts identical to the official backend on 17 / 17 clips, logit gap equal to a direct generate call (max diff 0.0); the authors' vLLM engine is not reproduced. Every benchmark row ran on an RTX A6000 (ivi-cn023; 3,208 rows, 0 tool errors, 0 OOM, 0 unparsed; 36.6 GPU-h). GenBuster-200K, the source of GenBuster-Bench, is in its training data (paper Sec. 3), so GenBuster-Bench / ++ are IN-DISTRIBUTION; overlap of its other training sources (VBench-2.0, AIGVDBench, RewardData) with the four held subsets was not checked. Results: repro/video_agent_bench/ (spec.json, comparison.json, results/<subset>/*.json; logs repro/logs/wevis_wevis_w0_295637.out, wevis_wevis_w1_295640.out, wevis_wevis_w0_295611.out).

our_number.note: IN-DISTRIBUTION, 40% subsample (status reference, as Veritas++'s subsets), so not a held-out result. Official weights, greedy, audio off (the first ceil(0.4 n) sorted, sha256-named clips of every folder): 97.30 acc (95% Wilson 96.25-98.06; paper 97.7 inside), fake recall 99.19, F1 98.05, real acc 93.25 (paper, implied: 94.3); in-domain / OOD / wild fakes 99.5 / 99.25 / 96.67 vs 99.7 / 99.6 / 95.3. IN-DISTRIBUTION (GenBuster-200K is in its training data): 1st of 9 vs 8 video detectors (VINA 89.37), not a held-out result.
